releases.title: Room to explore. Room to fight.
releases.summary: Larger battlefields, a wider camera view and more reasons to scout the flanks.
changes: Every population setting now plays on a 72 by 72 battlefield, with more than twice the previous area.
Discover two finite food, wood and gold expansion pockets on each side. Nearby opening resources remain balanced between rivals.
Zoom farther out for an overview. Wheel and button zoom ease around your focus; small trackpad movements make smaller adjustments. Pinch follows your fingers, and Reduced motion keeps zoom immediate.

Villagers work through each gathering cycle faster for both players, with wood gathering matching food to help fund buildings and reinforcements. Resources still need real delivery, Farms still run out, and every recruit and building still costs resources.
AI workers keep looking for new resources when a search route is blocked, so trapped workers cannot use up the whole team's exploration plan. The opponent still has to scout before finding resources.

Standard now needs four minutes of Sacred control. Contests pause your clock and losing ownership resets it. Control race keeps banking its four minutes across captures; destroying the enemy Town Center still wins either mode.

releases.title: Your kingdom, ready to go
releases.summary: A proper welcome in your browser. A direct route into the game from your Home Screen.
changes: Learn the game and find installation steps for iPhone, iPad, Android and desktop.
Play in your browser whenever you prefer. Installation is optional.
Online update checks happen automatically. Ready updates apply at the main menu, with active matches and their results protected.
Find these release notes from the welcome page, main menu or Pause screen.

releases.title: Keep your kingdom in the fight
releases.summary: Clearer economy decisions and a new optional way to contest the map.
changes: Economy now warns when worked food is running low and explains finite Farms: 75 wood buys a field containing 300 food.
See production shortages, counter roles and rally destinations without relying on tooltips.
Economy and Army stay open when a selected unit falls, so the next reinforcement order remains within reach.
Control race offers cheaper paid Feudal and military buildings. Bank four minutes of exclusive Sacred control; contests pause scoring. Standard rules remain available.
Report a problem directly from the result screen using the existing private report flow.

releases.title: Less menu work. More strategy.
releases.summary: Mobile management, deliberate gestures and persistent settings.
changes: Reach Base, Economy and Army quickly, save two groups, and manage paid production away from home.
Reassign workers, follow raid warnings and locate the Sacred site while keeping the battlefield visible.
Adjust interface size, camera and audio preferences. Settings stay on this device.
Web audio routing and background transitions have been improved.
